chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan, from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm al-ʿAqīlī, raising it, said:

When Ibn Muljam struck Amīr al-Muʾminīn (عليه السلام), he said to al-Ḥasan: “O my son, when I die, then kill Ibn Muljam and dig for him in the rubbish dump.” Al-ʿAqīlī described the place as being at the gate of Ṭāq al-Maḥāmil, the place of the grillers and the sellers of heads. “Then cast him into it, for it is a valley from the valleys of Hell.”

key_terms.أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Amīr al-Muʾminīn, Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام
key_terms.ابْنُ مُلْجَمٍ: the assailant who struck Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام
key_terms.الْكُنَاسَةِ: the rubbish dump or sweepings place
key_terms.طَاقِ الْمَحَامِلِ: a named location or gate in the described area

ai.seo_question: What did Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام instruct al-Ḥasan عليه السلام to do with Ibn Muljam after his death?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates the instruction of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام to al-Ḥasan عليه السلام after Ibn Muljam struck him. It records both a directive concerning Ibn Muljam after his death and a description of the place where he was to be cast, identifying it as a valley from the valleys of Hell.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ali Bin Al Hassan, from Ali Bin Ibrahim Al Aqeyli, raising it, said,

‘When Ibn Muljim<sup>la</sup> struck Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>, he<sup>asws</sup> said to Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>: ‘O my<sup>asws</sup> son<sup>asws</sup>! When I<sup>asws</sup> pass away, so kill Ibn Muljim<sup>la</sup> and dig a grave for him<sup>la</sup> among the sweepings (rubbish dump)’, and Aqeyli (the narrator) described the place as being at the gate of Taaq Al-Mahamil, a place of barbequing the heads (of animals), ‘then throw him<sup>la</sup> into it, for it is a valley from the valleys of Hell’.
en.sarwar: 7. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ali ibn al-Hassan from Ali ibn Ibrahim al-‘Aqili, in a marfu‘ manner, yarfa‘uhu, has said the following.

“When ibn Muljam injured Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) he (Ali) said to al-Hassan (a.s.), “My son, when I will die, eliminate ibn Muljam, dig the ground for him in al-Kunasa (name of a place) and throw him therein. It is a valley of the valleys of Hell.” (According to ‘Aqili’s description al-Kunas is at the gate called ‘Taq al-Mahamil’ where people cook animals’s legs and heads for food)
